description.value: Tofino Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative that has served the remote surf and cycling community of Tofino for over 70 years, making it the main full-service grocery stop on this isolated stretch of Vancouver Island's west coast. As a Federated Co-operatives member store it carries a broad range of groceries and accommodates gluten-free, halal, and kosher dietary needs. The store also operates a gas bar on the same site (currently undergoing renovation).

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Tofino Co-op grocery store with online ordering and a 2026 AGM notice, corroborating the OSM supermarket tag and recent check_date of 2026-04-03. OSM diet tags (gluten_free, halal, kosher) were also verified on 2026-04-03. The website content is sparse due to CMS template rendering, so most amenity fields cannot be confirmed and remain null; the only clearly evidenced amenity is basic groceries from the shop=supermarket tag and the 'Online Grocery Order Form' on the website.
concerns: Website content is heavily CMS-template-rendered (numerous '${title}', '${loading}' artifacts), limiting amenity evidence extraction.
Phone number and address could not be independently confirmed from website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The only full-service supermarket in Tofino, a major cycling destination on Vancouver Island's west coast; essential resupply stop for any touring cyclist in the region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Co-op Gas Bar on the same site is noted as temporarily closed for renovation as of the website visit.
